source_authority: Committed 2026-10-21 Development export and native Development builder inspection on 2026-11-10. These additive definitions do not replace whole current forms.

new_form.generic_identity: Object_Type/Object_ID and Context_Type/Context_ID are text, so future processes can link other object types without PO-specific lookup columns.
new_form.claim_contract: Claim_Key is required with native No Duplicate Values. Only a successful unique insert owns an email send attempt.
new_form.history_contract: Retain every send and retry attempt. Status/stamps change only through the authenticated server helper; retries append a new attempt, never overwrite an earlier attempt.

territory_field.assignment: Existing native Territory edit form; never add a PM approval-role step.

user_access.preserve_defaults: All existing permission checkboxes and Approval_Routing_Enabled remain false by default.
user_access.validation_rule: Blank User can appear on multiple notification contacts. Duplicate-login checks run only for a nonblank User. A blank User cannot have approval routing enabled.
user_access.existing_workflow: Current live builder exposes Retire Modification Permission on load. Preserve it; no User autofill was observed. Verify any concurrent workflows before installation.

development_setup_utility.argument: action: string; Check or Apply only
development_setup_utility.scope: Authenticated application owner in Development only; no Custom API or automatic workflow
development_setup_utility.effects: Check is read-only. Explicit Apply reuses exact contact emails, creates missing notification-only contacts and sets empty/already-intended Settings lists. No email, native account, permission, Construction PM or Production changes.
development_setup_utility.native_lock: Existing Approval_Config_Lock with dedicated unique Lock_Key po-notification-setup
